title: Shared Dependency Cache and Checkout Upgrade Tasks
principles: Share safe package-download and browser caches through GitHub's default-branch restore rules.
Keep pull-request writes isolated by Git ref and keep secrets outside every key and path.
Use Bun for repository work; use checkout only to place reviewed Git source on the runner.
Keep every live install, provider operation and proof boundary intact.

globalVerification.commitPolicy: Commit only after focused policy, deployment-contract, documentation and full repository checks pass; use one immutable pull-request revision for hosted checkout and cache-key proof.
evidenceRequired: Exact content-only Bun and Chromium keys with ref-scoped write reasoning.
Exact checkout v7.0.1 SHA in all five workflows and executable policy owners.
Hosted pull-request Quality receipt for the immutable implementation revision.
Preserved teardown, provider, live-install and proof boundaries with explicit non-claims.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Focused Quality and docs-deployment workflow checks
nonClaims: Local workflow checks do not prove a hosted cache restore or provider operation.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: bun run check:docs, bun run check:runbooks and bun run verification
nonClaims: Historical cache and deployment receipts remain unchanged.

downstreamArtifactImpact.verification: Diff audit and canonical repository verification
nonClaims: No deployment, release, publication or consumer change is authorized or established.

tasks.title: Share dependency-cache restores safely
tasks.goal: Let pull requests restore matching main Bun and Chromium downloads without allowing pull-request writes to become trusted main caches.
outputs: negative fixtures for event-name and unsafe cache regressions
tasks.implementationPrompt: Remove github.event_name from every Bun and Chromium cache key. Preserve every invalidation input, exact cache action pin, non-fatal restore/save behavior, frozen install, Playwright install and complete command graph. Record that GitHub ref scope isolates writes while default-branch caches may be restored by pull requests. Never cache node_modules, secrets, provider state or receipts.
qualityAudits: Confirm no cache key or path contains a secret or repository-installed dependency tree.
Confirm pull-request and fork reads cannot make pull-request writes visible to main or sibling refs.
Confirm all live install, provider and proof commands remain present and ordered.

parentAudit.basis: Review the workflow diff, GitHub scope rule, policy fixtures and documentation-impact ledger.
parentAudit.recovery: Restore event-name keys or remove dependency caches while preserving every live install and command.

completionCriteria: Focused cache policy and deployment-contract checks pass.
Current owners explain shared restore and ref-scoped writes without rewriting historical receipts.
Parent review accepts the exact key and trust boundaries.

tasks.title: Upgrade and prove checkout v7
tasks.goal: Remove the retired action-runtime warning while preserving every workflow's source identity and Bun toolchain.
tasks.implementationPrompt: Replace only the actions/checkout v4.2.0 full SHA with the verified v7.0.1 full SHA in all five workflows and exact policy contracts. Preserve fetch-depth, persist-credentials, ref, triggers, permissions, concurrency and all Bun setup/commands. Prove the GitHub-hosted Quality path before closeout; do not invoke a deployment workflow for this maintenance change.
qualityAudits: Confirm every checkout pin is the same exact v7.0.1 commit and no floating tag remains.
Confirm checkout still only places Git source and all repository work remains Bun-owned.
Confirm hosted evidence is limited to Quality and does not claim deployment or provider state.

parentAudit.basis: Review the exact action provenance, workflow inputs, full local checks and hosted immutable-revision result.
parentAudit.recovery: Restore the prior checkout full SHA if the hosted runner cannot execute the Node.js 24 action runtime.

completionCriteria: One hosted pull-request Quality run passes on the exact implementation revision.
The SPEC, tasks, plan and proof receipt close consistently with a no-Changeset rationale.
